title: The Private Capture of Public Genius
summary: This article explores how publicly funded research and innovation often end up being captured by private corporations, leaving taxpayers without proportional benefit from their investment. It examines the tension between public good and private profit in the technology and research ecosystem.
problem_solved: It addresses the systemic issue of public resources and genius being privatized for corporate gain without adequate public return.
why_valuable: It highlights a critical policy concern about the disconnect between public investment in research and private appropriation of resulting innovations.
